official: DD.4.4.1 driverless autocross: straights no longer than 80 m, minimum width 3 m, minimum turning diameter 9 m, one lap 200–500 m. The length is the centerline arc length.
DD.4.4.3 staging places the front wheels 6 m behind the start. That is a vehicle position, not extra track.

assumptions: Assumption: corner count, S-curve, chicane, hairpin, and slalom frequencies are simulation controls. DD.4.4.1 allows those features but does not set their rates.
Assumption: the stopping zone is the first meters of the lap after the finish line, on the same centerline, because DD.4.4.4 says the stop is on the track.
Assumption: large orange cones mark the combined start/finish line. A closed lap has one timing line.
note: Use this file as ground truth. Do not infer the racing line, cone positions, or the stopping zone from the rendered meshes.
